title_zh: 承运人杂费 · WDF / Restow / Per diem
title_en: Carrier accessorials · WDF / Restow / Per diem

why_attention.summary_zh: 承运人杂费。近 90 天 WDF/restow/accessorial 抽样 ≥21，但绝大多数是快递/LTL 重量差异——海运 WDF 仍薄。近 7 天 counts=3。

definitions.def: Carrier charges beyond ocean freight (THC, demurrage, WDF, restow, amendment, etc.).
Weight Discrepancy Fee — commercial; e.g. Maersk when |SI weight − VGM| > threshold or VGM vs CSC/tare invalid.
Moving containers on vessel/yard due to plan change — cost often commercial opaque.
Often synonym/near to detention or chassis daily in US trades — check tariff wording.

who_pays.typical: Shipper/merchant per carrier invoice; NOT an administrative fine.

common_pitfalls: Writing WDF into fine_refs as government penalty.
Inventing restow USD amounts without tariff URL.
Confusing courier 'weight discrepancy' tweets with ocean WDF.

official_sources.note: ID refresher: WDF USD 300/container; >3000 kg SI vs VGM; VGM>max gross; VGM<tare (commercial)
2024-10-15 effective update — USD 300 world origins stated
2026-05-07 cutoff-date billing + pre-notification; tank threshold 5000 kg
VGM statutory backdrop for WDF commercial overlays

country_hooks.note: Maersk WDF PDF advisory also for SG local info

faq.a: 公开 advisory 写 USD 300/柜（条件：SI 与 VGM 差 >3000 kg 等）。这是承运人费，不是行政罚。以船司当期通知为准（2026-05 起计费时点改到 cutoff）。
可靠公开价目稀缺；禁止编造。有 dated tariff URL 再写入 L4。

x_evidence.honesty: search for WDF|restow|accessorial returned mostly India courier Shiprocket disputes — not ocean. Prefer Maersk URLs over X.

disclaimer: Not legal advice. Commercial fees ≠ administrative fines. Amounts require source URL + as_of. X evidence is heat/wording only.
